subject: business_studies
chapter_title: Social Responsibilities of Business and Business Ethics

concepts.title: Concept and Kinds of Social Responsibility
concepts.definition: Social responsibility of business is its obligation to act in ways that serve the interests of society along with its own interests, covering economic, legal, ethical and discretionary responsibilities towards owners, employees, consumers, government and community.
concepts.key_idea: Business uses society's resources, so it owes quality goods, fair prices, safe jobs and clean environment back to its stakeholders.

concepts.title: Need for Social Responsibility and Its Arguments
concepts.definition: Business owes its existence to society and uses its resources, public expectations demand responsible conduct, long term self interest and avoidance of government regulation support responsibility, and the arguments against it of profit motive violation, burden on consumers and lack of social skills are outweighed by the reality of social power.
concepts.key_idea: Reality of social power, public expectations, moral justification and long run self interest together press business towards responsibility.

concepts.title: Business Ethics: Elements and Social Responsibility of Environmental Protection
concepts.definition: Business ethics are the moral principles governing business conduct, based on elements like top management commitment, publication of a code, establishment of compliance mechanism, employee involvement and measuring results, and environmental protection is now a central social responsibility with laws on pollution control.
concepts.key_idea: Ethical conduct goes beyond law: it asks what is right, and a written code with compliance machinery turns ethics into daily behaviour.
